summary: Obsidian Energy filed a Form 6-K reporting voting results from its annual and special meeting of shareholders. All seven director nominees were elected, and shareholders approved the appointment of KPMG as auditor, the advisory vote on executive compensation, amendments to the stock option plan, and unallocated awards under the stock option and share unit plans. The filing is a routine disclosure of meeting outcomes and does not involve any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change.
